recipe.name: UwU Minecraft bot
evidence: start runs tools/boot.sh under Bun: repairs+verifies 26.3 support, then execs standalone.js
NOT a web service: readiness is RCON (port 25575, 'list'), not HTTP. The verify
harness only polls HTTP (recipes.py reads readinessPath; there is no command hook),
so the readiness phase always reports Connection refused on a healthy bot.
Use: hermes verify --skip-start  (phases are the real signal)
Then: systemctl is-active uwu-bot + RCON 'list' for liveness.
